About SubBase Construction Procurement Platform

# We’re on a mission to streamline material management by simplifying workflows

## Our story

SubBase is a platform streamlining construction material management for subcontractors and self-performing GCs. It replaces the chaotic mix of emails, texts, and spreadsheets with a single, user-friendly platform across all stakeholders. With SubBase, users can simplify procurement processes and boost efficiency without changing their current workflow!

Our team is composed of industry professionals who have firsthand experience with the complexities of material management. We deeply understand the headaches associated with managing disparate material workflows and have learned from the ground up how to solve the many problems associated with construction material procurement. SubBase was created to bridge the gap between technology and construction and empower professionals to navigate the intricacies of material management with ease connecting the field, office and vendors in one spot. We're on a mission to streamline material management for contractors and suppliers by simplifying workflows, enhancing communication and providing unparalleled visibility, all while offering seamless financial integration to empower every stakeholder involved. By improving the fractured and disparate building materials ecosystem, we aim to provide a comprehensive solution for planning, procurement, tracking, and payments, ultimately enhancing transparency and efficiency for all stakeholders involved.

Eric Helitzer Founder and CEO of SubBase

Having grown up in a family deeply embedded in the building process, it was a natural progression for me to address a glaring industry issue after witnessing firsthand the struggles and inefficiencies at the subcontractor level for so many years. SubBase was forged with relentless dedication and passion, crafted for the people who bring these buildings to life. By resolving today's material procurement challenges, we are paving the way for a brighter future for every stakeholder involved.

### We’re dependable

We believe in tech that makes an impact. We know that people aren’t always in favor of change, so we aren’t changing processes. We’re building workflows people can trust.

## We’re customer-centric

We always put our customers first. We acknowledge decades of fragmented and disparate workflows and transform that into streamlined processes.

## We’re partners

We know the material procurement process is complex, and SubBase simplifies it by partnering with our customers.

## We’re deep-rooted

We come from years of industry experience. We recognize the pain points faced by our customers and we are passionate about positively enhancing their workflow.

## We’re persistent 

We are continuously improving our software, remaining at the forefront of construction material management by incorporating the latest technologies and best practices.

## Vendor Network

The Network offers suppliers and vendors the opportunity to streamline their workflow in the most organized way. Stay ahead of your competition, provide maximum value to customers
